verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents snoozing messages so they return to the Inbox at a chosen time (features page, plus the offline-support note on snoozed messages reappearing), which covers the snooze half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows follow-up reminders that resurface a thread when nobody replies. Missing for 10: follow-up/no-reply reminder capability, conversation-level snooze detail, independent or hands-on corroboration of snooze.
